author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: वर्णाश्रमान्तरधर्मस्तु भयावहः । निषिद्धत्वात् अनर्थप्रापको यतोऽत इत्यर्थः
translation: V. One's own duty: the duty which one has to perform as enjoined upon the caste or order one belongs to. Defective : not duly performed in all its details. The duty of another : the duty laid down for some other caste and order to which one does not belong. Brings fear: for to follow another's duty is on his part a transgression and violation of the sacred laws, for whiclı punishment awaits him.
